result.summary: The page appears to be a well-rendered food delivery app home screen with no critical or major visual breakages. All sections, navigation, typography, icons, and images display consistently. One minor observational issue exists with the truncated restaurant name on the partially visible third card in the horizontally scrolling 'Fastest near you' list.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list shows 'Trattoria Picco' with the full name truncated/cut off at the card edge, making the complete restaurant name unreadable without scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Either widen the card to fit common restaurant name lengths, apply an ellipsis (...) to indicate truncation, or increase the horizontal peek offset so the full text of partially visible cards remains legible.
